kind.description: What the subject is. Only `post` is used today.

active.description: True = shown in the splash carousel. False = retired but kept for the Featured archive.

layout.description: Tile size in the public Featured grid: square (1x1), wide (2x1), or tall (1x2). Absent = square.

subject.description: Strong-ref to the featured post (or, later, collection).

position.description: Admin sort order within the active set (lower = earlier).

main.description: An admin-curated featured item, written to the dedicated curator repo (feeder.psky.social). Currently always a post; `kind` future-proofs featured collections. `active=false` pulls the item from the splash carousel but keeps it for the Inspire > Featured archive. Reorder = putRecord with a new `position`; unfeature = putRecord with active=false; hard-remove = deleteRecord.
